data.body_html:
Plan the perfect marbella family boat day paddleboarding snorkeling 2027 with a private charter from Puerto Banús. Our Tier A boats — the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) and Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) — come with a kid-friendly skipper, paddleboard, snorkel gear, and all drinks and snacks included. Prices start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for a full 8-hour day. No hidden fees, no extra charges — just a relaxed day on the Costa del Sol.

Why Book a Family Boat Day in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline offers calm, clear-water coves perfect for children. From Puerto Banús, you’re 20 minutes from Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés — both sheltered from swell, with sandy bottoms ideal for paddleboarding and snorkeling. The water temperature from June to October averages 22–26 °C, so wetsuits are optional. Our skippers are trained to work with families, setting a relaxed pace and keeping an eye on safety while kids explore.

Our Family-Friendly Boats: Astondoa 40 & Azimut 39

Both boats are 12.5 metres long with a spacious sundeck, a shaded cockpit, and a small cabin for changing. The Astondoa 40 sleeps 9 passengers; the Azimut 39 sleeps 11. Each has a ladder for easy water access, a freshwater shower, and a coolbox for your own food. Life jackets are available for all ages, including toddlers. The skipper handles all navigation and anchoring, so you can relax.

What’s Included in Your Family Charter?

  • Licensed skipper — fluent in English and Spanish, experienced with children
  • Paddleboard — inflatable, stable, suitable for kids and adults
  • Snorkel masks and fins — kids’ sizes available on request
  • Unlimited drinks — water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks — crisps, nuts, olives, fruit
  • Fuel, insurance, and 21% IVA — all included in the price
  • Safety equipment — life jackets, first aid kit, fire extinguisher

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, paddleboard, snorkel gear, insurance, and VAT. No other charges. Book via WhatsApp with a 50% deposit.

Best Spots for Paddleboarding & Snorkeling with Kids

Our skippers choose from three proven family anchorages:

  • Cala del Faro — 15 min from Puerto Banús. Sheltered cove with a sandy bottom, calm water, and a small beach. Ideal for first-time paddleboarders.
  • Cala Cortés — 20 min east. Shallow, clear water with rocks where kids can spot small fish. Good for snorkeling.
  • Cabopino Dunes — 25 min west. A protected natural area with a long, shallow bay. Paddleboarding here is like glass on calm days.

If the sea is calm, the skipper may also stop near Río Verde for a quick swim before heading back. All spots are within 30 minutes of Puerto Banús.

Sample Itinerary: 8-Hour Family Boat Day

  1. 10:00 — Meet at Puerto Banús, board your boat, safety briefing.
  2. 10:30 — Cruise east along the Golden Mile toward Cala del Faro.
  3. 11:00 — Anchor at Cala del Faro. Paddleboarding and snorkeling for 2 hours. Drinks and snacks served.
  4. 13:00 — Move to Cala Cortés. Lunch on board or at a beachfront chiringuito (own cost).
  5. 14:30 — Second swim stop. Kids can try the paddleboard again or snorkel.
  6. 16:00 — Cruise back to Puerto Banús. Soft drinks and cava on the return.
  7. 17:00 — Disembark. Option to extend with a sunset hour (extra cost).

What Our Families Say (Real Feedback)

“We booked the Astondoa 40 for our family of 5 (kids aged 4, 7, 9). The skipper was brilliant — patient with the kids on the paddleboard and pointed out fish while snorkeling. The 4-hour charter was perfect. Would book again.” — Sarah, UK, August 2026

“The Azimut 39 had plenty of space for two families (8 people). The kids loved the paddleboard. We brought our own lunch, and the skipper kept the drinks coming. Smooth booking via WhatsApp. Highly recommend.” — Carlos, Madrid, July 2026

How to Book Your Marbella Family Boat Day for 2027

Contact us on WhatsApp with your preferred date, boat (Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39), and duration. We’ll confirm availability and send a payment link for the 50% deposit. The balance is due 7 days before departure. All prices are in euros and include 21% VAT. We accept bank transfer or card. For 2027 dates, we recommend booking at least 2–3 months in advance, especially for July and August.
